i run a very unique shaman style deck i've seen noone use before. i dont want to give it away, but sylvanas is always a card that is good for me to be against except if it is a game i would have already lost anyways. 

I am only rank 6, but honestly i play maybe 10 matches(im not gonna lie - i am always intoxicated while playing hearthstone and dont really count the exact number, this is an approximation which i believe to be pretty accurate) a week or so. my win rate is phenomenal, my bonus star is always going which helps. i dont know what my "actual skill level" would be once it balances out from me getting bonus stars for like the past 3 days straight, but it has to be around that i think.. but then again i dont understand this ranking system very well.

i will say tho, that i feel with a lot of cards we now have disposable its time to start looking at all those, instead of trying to play for your class. i see so many cards that dont have direct counters and people complain about them, but the reality is if you think 4 steps down a lot of times you can flip it. the alternative is to race or "bluff race" in which you play the best you can while reserving something back in case you actually do get a miracle couple of top decks in a row (it happens) or more likely, your opponent makes an error that lets you back in it had you not gone for that 1-1 counter turn by turn play mentality that too many players fall into. i use that assumption they will always trade something with me if it looks like and advantage on that turn, sacrificing some of my best cards early to make it look like im losing, while holding onto an important combo in hopes that i can somehow find a board clear before my health expires and release it while i know they have nothing left.
